data.body: **[P1] A scope `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath` reported after this check but before `execute()` returns is still lost by the invocation caller.** For example, if scope cleanup fails while an end hook or `ExecutionManager.close()` is blocked, only the daemon worker dies and the caller returns the selected `PENDING`/`RETRYING` outcome. Capture the outcome, close the manager, then recheck `scopeFatal` before returning or rethrowing; update the late-fatal regression to require propagation whenever the fatal is observed before `execute()` exits.
